text: Choose a sticky left sidebar that collapses to a thin tab when unused. name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky left sidebar still risks users missing updates if they’re deep in the graph—focused users scan the center, not the edge. name: Pane
text: Pane: A full-width top banner buries the graph under a second layer of chrome—users scroll to see data, not controls. The real risk is turning the interface into a dashboard that feels like a spreadsheet, not a living visualization. Settle it by testing a hybrid: a thin, sticky top strip for critical actions, paired with a collapsible left sidebar for context—then measure where users actually look.
